cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a threat monitoring professional and leader to join our team in an embedded role within a client's Crisis Management team. Reporting to the client's security leadership, the Embedded Team Leader will co-direct a 24/7 team of analysts as part of a tight-knit operation providing actionable intelligence and advice to decision makers.
This position will manage the process for gathering timely and accurate information and intelligence on physical threats and risks to the client globally. The candidate must have previous exposure to tactical and operational security work in a leadership capacity, having worked their way up through the ranks of a GSOC, SOC or similar physical threat monitoring team (e.g., Operator, to Supervisor, to Lead). Candidates must have strong analysis skills, and be technically savvy with the ability to skilfully conceptualize and synthesise disparate information.
The candidate will be managed by the client's team leader day-to-day, but will also report to [Company name masked]'s Intelligence Operations team.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Security Studies, International Relations, Criminal Justice, Business Management, or a related field
At least 3-5 years of relevant experience in physical threat monitoring, corporate intelligence and/or a geopolitical analysis-focused role
At least 1-3 years of leadership/management experience
Expert knowledge of threat monitoring tools, open-source research techniques, and mass notification systems (e.g. Everbridge)
Knowledge and awareness of geopolitical risks, crime trends, terrorism, armed conflict, and environmental hazards, among other emerging threats
Strong awareness of how global security incidents are liable to impact private-sector staff, assets, and operations – particularly in the technology sector
Fluency in English (both written and verbal)
Ability to manipulate and visualise data, using advanced research skills
Ability to rapidly digest, evaluate and ""sift"" large quantities of information
Ability to quickly determine how security events and crises impact business operations
Analytical flair: the ability to provide rigorous, creative insight into complex situations
Able to work in both individual and team environments
Excellent attention to detail
High level of competency with MS Office tools
A visionary mindset, with the ability to inspire others through expert guidance
Preferred Requirements
Advanced (Master's or above) degree in a relevant subject
Foreign language skills
Experience and technical competency with analytical software (e.g. IBM i2, Tableau, Splunk, Recorded Future, Palantir etc.)
Knowledge or expertise in at least one of the following: (1) environmental hazards, natural disasters and/or climate change risks; or (2) geographic information system (GIS) mapping software (e.g. ESRI)
Cross-functional experience within a global security team (e.g. Threat monitoring, travel security, business continuity and crisis management), particularly in a leadership role

cond_0109.intro:

Reporting to the client's security leadership, the Embedded Team Leader will co-direct a 24/7 team of analysts as part of a tight-knit operation providing actionable intelligence and advice to decision makers.

Candidates must have strong analysis skills, and be technically savvy with the ability to skilfully conceptualize and synthesise disparate information.

cond_0159.intro:
We are looking for an Embedded Threat Analyst Team Leader to join our team.
[Company name masked] is looking for a strong threat monitoring professional and leader to take on an embedded role within a client's Crisis Management team. Based in [Location masked] and reporting to the client's security leadership, the Embedded Team Leader will co-direct a 24/7 team of analysts spread across [Location masked], [Location masked] and [Location masked] as part of a close-knit operation providing actionable intelligence and advice to decision makers.
This position manages the process for gathering timely and accurate information and intelligence on physical threats and risks to the client globally. The ideal candidate must be adaptable in a high-volume environment and must have previous exposure to tactical and operational security work in a leadership capacity, having worked up through the ranks of a GSOC, SOC or similar physical threat monitoring team (e.g., Operator, to Supervisor, to Lead). Candidates must have strong analysis skills and be technically capable, with the ability to conceptualise and synthesise disparate information.
The candidate will be managed by the client's team leader day-to-day, but will also report to [Company name masked]'s Intelligence Operations team.
cond_0159.responsibilities:
Supervise the team's monitoring of open source, social media and vendor feeds for security risks and threats, staying in regular contact with team members to keep coverage consistent and timely.
Draft and review incident alerts and analytical reports that are timely, credible, and provide actionable insight; communicate findings clearly to internal Crisis Management stakeholders on an ongoing basis.
Provide thought leadership for internal stakeholders during ongoing incidents, actively contributing to senior management updates and crisis management / EMT briefings.
Work closely with the client team on a daily basis to optimise processes and SOPs for delivering emergency notifications and assessments to internal customers.
Demonstrate keen awareness for the concerns and needs of the client's staff and operations during emergencies and crises, engaging directly with relevant parties when necessary.
Collaborate regularly with other team leaders to develop and innovate assessment techniques, supporting the growth of the threat monitoring function within the client company.
Apply creative thinking and consulting skills to deliver a continually improving service for the client, staying in close contact with stakeholders to understand their evolving needs.
Lead a small team effectively, focused on lean, high-impact delivery, while fostering a culture of resilience and innovation through open communication and regular engagement.
Work flexibly to ensure that client intelligence requirements are met.
cond_0159.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Security Studies, International Relations, Criminal Justice, Business Management, or a related field.
At least 3-5 years of relevant experience in physical threat monitoring, corporate intelligence and / or a geopolitical analysis-focused role.
At least 1-3 years of leadership / management experience.
Expert knowledge of threat monitoring tools, open-source research techniques, and mass notification systems (e.g. Everbridge).
Knowledge and awareness of geopolitical risks, crime trends, terrorism, armed conflict, and environmental hazards, among other emerging threats.
Strong awareness of how global security incidents are liable to impact private-sector staff, assets, and operations – particularly in the technology sector.
Fluency in English (both written and verbal).
Ability to manipulate and visualise data, using advanced research skills.
Ability to rapidly digest, evaluate and sift large quantities of information.
Ability to inspire others through expert guidance.
Ability to quickly determine how security events and crises impact business operations.
Analytical flair: the ability to provide rigorous, creative insight into complex situations.
Able to work in both individual and team environments.
Excellent attention to detail.
High level of competency with MS Office tools.
Advanced (Master's or above) degree in a relevant subject.
Foreign language skills.
Experience and technical competency with analytical software (e.g. IBM i2, Tableau, Splunk, Recorded Future, Palantir etc.).
Knowledge or expertise in at least one of the following: (1) environmental hazards, natural disasters and/or climate change risks; or (2) geographic information system (GIS) mapping software (e.g. ESRI).
Cross-functional experience within a global security team (e.g. Threat monitoring, travel security, business continuity and crisis management), particularly in a leadership role.

cond_0169.intro:
We are looking for an Embedded Threat Analyst Team Leader to join our team.
[Company name masked] is looking for a threat monitoring professional and leader for an embedded role within a client's Crisis Management team. Based in [Location masked] and reporting to the client's security leadership, the Embedded Team Leader will co-direct a 24/7 team of analysts spread across [Location masked], [Location masked] and [Location masked], providing actionable intelligence and advice to decision makers.
This position manages the process for gathering timely and accurate information and intelligence on physical threats and risks to the client globally. The ideal candidate must be adaptable in a high-volume environment and must have previous exposure to tactical and operational security work in a leadership capacity, having worked through the ranks of a GSOC, SOC or similar physical threat monitoring team (e.g., Operator, to Supervisor, to Lead). Coordinate with the client team to optimise processes and SOPs for delivering emergency notifications and assessments to internal customers
Maintain awareness of the concerns and needs of the client's staff and operations during emergencies and crises, engaging directly when required
Support the growth of the threat monitoring function within the client company by working with other team leaders to develop and improve assessment techniques
Apply structured thinking and analytical skills to deliver a continually improving service for the client, supporting the global business
Lead a small team focused on the delivery of lean, high-impact services, maintaining a culture of resilience and sound practice
Work flexibly to ensure that client intelligence requirements are met

Bachelor's degree in Security Studies, International Relations, Criminal Justice, Business Management, or a related field

At least 1–3 years of leadership/management experience
Expert knowledge of threat monitoring tools, open-source research techniques, and mass notification systems (e.g. Everbridge)
Knowledge and awareness of geopolitical risks, crime trends, terrorism, armed conflict, and environmental hazards, among other emerging threats
Strong awareness of how global security incidents are liable to impact private-sector staff, assets, and operations – particularly in the technology sector
Fluency in English (both written and verbal)

Ability to rapidly digest, evaluate and sift large quantities of information
Ability to quickly determine how security events and crises impact business operations

Excellent attention to detail
High level of competency with MS Office tools
Clear, direct written and verbal communication skills
Preferred Requirements
Advanced (Master's or above) degree in a relevant subject
Foreign language skills
Experience and technical competency with analytical software (e.g. IBM i2, Tableau, Splunk, Recorded Future, Palantir etc.)
Knowledge or expertise in at least one of the following: (1) environmental hazards, natural disasters and/or climate change risks; or (2) geographic information system (GIS) mapping software (e.g. ESRI)
Cross-functional experience within a global security team (e.g. Threat monitoring, travel security, business continuity and crisis management), particularly in a leadership role

Advanced (Master's or above) degree in a relevant subject
Foreign language skills

Cross-functional experience within a global security team (e.g. Threat monitoring, travel security, business continuity and crisis management), particularly in a leadership role

cond_0190.intro:
We are looking for an Embedded Threat Analyst Team Leader to join our team. The role sits within a client's Crisis Management team. Reporting to the client's security leadership, the Embedded Team Leader will co-direct a 24/7 team of analysts spread across multiple locations as part of a tight-knit operation providing actionable intelligence and advice to decision makers.
This position will manage the process for gathering timely and accurate information / intelligence on physical threats and risks to the client globally. The ideal candidate must be adaptable in a high-volume environment. The candidate must have previous exposure to tactical and operational security work in a leadership capacity, having worked their way up through the ranks of a GSOC, SOC or similar physical threat monitoring team (e.g., Operator, to Supervisor, to Lead). Candidates must have strong analysis skills, and be technically savvy with the ability to skilfully conceptualize and synthesise disparate information.
The candidate will be managed by the client's team leader day-to-day, but will also report to [Company name masked]'s Intelligence Operations team.

[Company name masked] is looking for a threat monitoring professional and leader for an embedded role within a client's Crisis Management team. Based in [Location masked] and reporting to the client's security leadership, the Embedded Team Leader will co-direct a 24/7 team of analysts spread across [Location masked], [Location masked] and [Location masked], providing actionable intelligence and advice to decision makers.
This position manages the process for gathering timely and accurate information and intelligence on physical threats and risks to the client globally. The ideal candidate must be adaptable in a high-volume environment and must have previous exposure to tactical and operational security work in a leadership capacity, having worked through the ranks of a GSOC, SOC or similar physical threat monitoring team (e.g., Operator, to Supervisor, to Lead). Candidates must have strong analysis skills and be technically capable, with the ability to conceptualise and synthesise disparate information.
The candidate will be managed by the client's team leader day-to-day, but will also report to [Company name masked]'s Intelligence Operations team.
cond_0223.responsibilities:
Supervise the team's monitoring of open source, social media and vendor feeds for security risks and threats
Draft and review incident alerts and analytical reports that are timely, credible, and provide actionable insight to internal Crisis Management stakeholders
Provide input to internal stakeholders during ongoing incidents, senior management updates and crisis management / EMT briefings
Coordinate with the client team to optimise processes and SOPs for delivering emergency notifications and assessments to internal customers
Maintain awareness of the concerns and needs of the client's staff and operations during emergencies and crises, engaging directly when required
Support the growth of the threat monitoring function within the client company by working with other team leaders to develop and improve assessment techniques
Apply structured thinking and analytical skills to deliver a continually improving service for the client, supporting the global business
Lead a small team focused on the delivery of lean, high-impact services, maintaining a culture of resilience and sound practice
Work flexibly to ensure that client intelligence requirements are met
cond_0223.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Security Studies, International Relations, Criminal Justice, Business Management, or a related field
At least 3–5 years of relevant experience in physical threat monitoring, corporate intelligence and/or a geopolitical analysis-focused role
At least 1–3 years of leadership/management experience
Expert knowledge of threat monitoring tools, open-source research techniques, and mass notification systems (e.g. Everbridge)
Knowledge and awareness of geopolitical risks, crime trends, terrorism, armed conflict, and environmental hazards, among other emerging threats
Strong awareness of how global security incidents are liable to impact private-sector staff, assets, and operations – particularly in the technology sector
Fluency in English (both written and verbal)
Ability to manipulate and visualise data using advanced research skills
Ability to rapidly digest, evaluate and sift large quantities of information
Ability to quickly determine how security events and crises impact business operations
Analytical ability: providing rigorous, creative insight into complex situations
Able to work in both individual and team environments
Excellent attention to detail
High level of competency with MS Office tools
Clear, direct written and verbal communication skills
Preferred Requirements
Advanced (Master's or above) degree in a relevant subject
Foreign language skills
Experience and technical competency with analytical software (e.g. IBM i2, Tableau, Splunk, Recorded Future, Palantir etc.)
Knowledge or expertise in at least one of the following: (1) environmental hazards, natural disasters and/or climate change risks; or (2) geographic information system (GIS) mapping software (e.g. ESRI)
Cross-functional experience within a global security team (e.g. Threat monitoring, travel security, business continuity and crisis management), particularly in a leadership role

cond_0242.intro:
We are looking for an Embedded Threat Analyst Team Leader to join our team.
[Company name masked] is looking for an outstanding threat monitoring professional and leader to join us in an embedded role within a client's Crisis Management team. Based in [Location masked] and reporting to the client's security leadership, the Embedded Team Leader will co-direct a 24/7 team of analysts spread across [Location masked], [Location masked] and [Location masked] as part of a tight-knit operation delivering actionable intelligence and advice to decision makers.
This position will own the process for gathering timely and accurate information / intelligence on physical threats and risks to the client globally. The ideal candidate must be adaptable in a high-volume environment. The candidate must have previous exposure to tactical and operational security work in a leadership capacity, having worked their way up through the ranks of a GSOC, SOC or similar physical threat monitoring team (e.g., Operator, to Supervisor, to Lead). cond_0242.requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Security Studies, International Relations, Criminal Justice, Business Management, or a related field
At least 3-5 years of relevant experience in physical threat monitoring, corporate intelligence and / or a geopolitical analysis-focused role
At least 1-3 years of leadership / management experience
Expert knowledge of threat monitoring tools, open-source research techniques, and mass notification systems (e.g. Everbridge)
Knowledge and awareness of geopolitical risks, crime trends, terrorism, armed conflict, and environmental hazards, among other emerging threats
Strong awareness of how global security incidents are liable to impact private-sector staff, assets, and operations – particularly in the technology sector
Fluency in English (both written and verbal)
Ability to manipulate and visualise data, using advanced research skills
Ability to rapidly digest, evaluate and ""sift"" large quantities of information
Ability to quickly determine how security events and crises impact business operations
Analytical flair: the ability to provide rigorous, creative insight into complex situations
Able to work in both individual and team environments
Excellent attention to detail
High level of competency with MS Office tools
A visionary mindset, with the ability to inspire others through expert guidance
Preferred Requirements
Advanced (Master's or above) degree in a relevant subject
Foreign language skills
Experience and technical competency with analytical software (e.g. IBM i2, Tableau, Splunk, Recorded Future, Palantir etc.)
Knowledge or expertise in at least one of the following: (1) environmental hazards, natural disasters and/or climate change risks; or (2) geographic information system (GIS) mapping software (e.g. ESRI)

cond_0252.intro:
[Company name masked] is looking for a threat monitoring professional and leader to join in an embedded role within a client's Crisis Management team. Based in [Location masked] and reporting to the client's security leadership, the Embedded Team Leader will help co-direct a 24/7 team of analysts spread across multiple locations as part of an operation providing actionable intelligence and advice to decision makers.
This position involves coordinating the process for gathering timely and accurate information and intelligence on physical threats and risks to the client globally. The ideal candidate will have previous exposure to tactical and operational security work in a leadership capacity, having worked through the ranks of a GSOC, SOC or similar physical threat monitoring team (e.g., Operator, to Supervisor, to Lead). Candidates must have strong analysis skills and be technically capable, with the ability to synthesise disparate information.
The candidate will work alongside the client's team leader day-to-day, and will also report to [Company name masked]'s Intelligence Operations team.

We are looking for an Embedded Threat Analyst Team Leader to join our team.
[Company name masked] is looking for a threat monitoring professional and leader to join in an embedded role within a client's Crisis Management team. Reporting to the client's security leadership, the Embedded Team Leader will help co-direct a 24/7 team of analysts spread across [Location masked] as part of an operation providing actionable intelligence and advice to decision makers.
This position involves coordinating the process for gathering timely and accurate information and intelligence on physical threats and risks to the client globally. The ideal candidate will have previous exposure to tactical and operational security work in a leadership capacity, having worked through the ranks of a GSOC, SOC or similar physical threat monitoring team (e.g., Operator, to Supervisor, to Lead). Candidates must have strong analysis skills and be technically capable, with the ability to synthesise disparate information.
The candidate will work alongside the client's team leader day-to-day, and will also report to [Company name masked]'s Intelligence Operations team.
cond_0261.responsibilities:
Help supervise the team's monitoring of open source, social media and vendor feeds for security risks and threats
Collaborate on drafting and reviewing incident alerts and analytical reports that are timely, credible, and provide actionable insight to internal Crisis Management stakeholders
Share expertise with internal stakeholders during ongoing incidents, senior management updates and crisis management / EMT briefings
Work with the client team to optimise processes and SOPs for delivering emergency notifications and assessments to internal customers
Stay attuned to the concerns and needs of the client's staff and operations during emergencies and crises, engaging directly if necessary
Support the growth of the threat monitoring function within the client company by working in collaboration with other team leaders to develop and innovate assessment techniques
Coordinate with colleagues to deliver a continually improving service for the client, supporting the global business
Lead a small team with a shared focus on lean, high-impact services, while helping foster a culture of resilience and innovation
Work flexibly alongside the team to ensure that client intelligence requirements are met
cond_0261.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Security Studies, International Relations, Criminal Justice, Business Management, or a related field
At least 3-5 years of relevant experience in physical threat monitoring, corporate intelligence and/or a geopolitical analysis-focused role
At least 1-3 years of leadership/management experience
Expert knowledge of threat monitoring tools, open-source research techniques, and mass notification systems (e.g. Everbridge)
Knowledge and awareness of geopolitical risks, crime trends, terrorism, armed conflict, and environmental hazards, among other emerging threats
Strong awareness of how global security incidents are liable to impact private-sector staff, assets, and operations – particularly in the technology sector
Fluency in English (both written and verbal)
Ability to manipulate and visualise data, using advanced research skills
Ability to rapidly digest, evaluate and sift large quantities of information
Ability to quickly determine how security events and crises impact business operations
Analytical flair: the ability to provide rigorous, creative insight into complex situations
Excellent attention to detail
High level of competency with MS Office tools
Preferred Requirements
Advanced (Master's or above) degree in a relevant subject
Foreign language skills
Experience and technical competency with analytical software (e.g. IBM i2, Tableau, Splunk, Recorded Future, Palantir etc.)
Knowledge or expertise in at least one of the following: (1) environmental hazards, natural disasters and/or climate change risks; or (2) geographic information system (GIS) mapping software (e.g. ESRI)
Cross-functional experience within a global security team (e.g. Threat monitoring, travel security, business continuity and crisis management), particularly in a leadership role
A visionary mindset, with the ability to inspire others through expert guidance

Based in [Location masked] and reporting to the client's security leadership, the Embedded Team Leader will co-direct a 24/7 team of analysts spread across [Location masked], [Location masked] and [Location masked] as part of a tight-knit operation providing actionable intelligence and advice to decision makers.
This position will manage the process for gathering timely and accurate information / intelligence on physical threats and risks to the client globally. The ideal candidate must be adaptable in a high-volume environment. The candidate must have previous exposure to tactical and operational security work in a leadership capacity, having worked their way up through the ranks of a GSOC, SOC or similar physical threat monitoring team (e.g., Operator, to Supervisor, to Lead). Candidates must have strong analysis skills, and be technically savvy with the ability to skilfully conceptualize and synthesise disparate information.
The candidate will be managed by the client's team leader day-to-day, but will also report to [Company name masked]'s Intelligence Operations team. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of physical threat monitoring and how security events connect to business impact.
cond_0364.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Security Studies, International Relations, Criminal Justice, Business Management, or a related field
At least 3-5 years of relevant experience in physical threat monitoring, corporate intelligence and / or a geopolitical analysis-focused role
At least 1-3 years of leadership / management experience
Expert knowledge of threat monitoring tools, open-source research techniques, and mass notification systems (e.g. Everbridge)
Knowledge and awareness of geopolitical risks, crime trends, terrorism, armed conflict, and environmental hazards, among other emerging threats
Strong awareness of how global security incidents are liable to impact private-sector staff, assets, and operations – particularly in the technology sector
Fluency in English (both written and verbal)
Ability to manipulate and visualise data, using advanced research skills
Ability to rapidly digest, evaluate and ""sift"" large quantities of information
Ability to quickly determine how security events and crises impact business operations
Analytical flair: the ability to provide rigorous, creative insight into complex situations
Able to work in both individual and team environments
Excellent attention to detail
High level of competency with MS Office tools
Preferred Requirements
Advanced (Master's or above) degree in a relevant subject
Foreign language skills
Experience and technical competency with analytical software (e.g. IBM i2, Tableau, Splunk, Recorded Future, Palantir etc.)
Knowledge or expertise in at least one of the following: (1) environmental hazards, natural disasters and/or climate change risks; or (2) geographic information system (GIS) mapping software (e.g. ESRI)
Cross-functional experience within a global security team (e.g. Threat monitoring, travel security, business continuity and crisis management), particularly in a leadership role
A visionary mindset, with the ability to inspire others through expert guidance

[Company name masked] is looking for an outstanding threat monitoring professional and leader to join us in an embedded role within a client's Crisis Management team. Based in [Location masked] and reporting to the client's security leadership, the Embedded Team Leader will co-direct a 24/7 team of analysts spread across [Location masked], [Location masked] and [Location masked] as part of a tight-knit operation delivering actionable intelligence and advice to decision makers.
This position will own the process for gathering timely and accurate information / intelligence on physical threats and risks to the client globally. The ideal candidate must be adaptable in a high-volume environment. The candidate must have previous exposure to tactical and operational security work in a leadership capacity, having worked their way up through the ranks of a GSOC, SOC or similar physical threat monitoring team (e.g., Operator, to Supervisor, to Lead). Candidates must have strong analysis skills, and be technically savvy with the ability to skilfully conceptualize and synthesise disparate information.
The candidate will be managed by the client's team leader day-to-day, but will also report to [Company name masked]'s Intelligence Operations team.
cond_0530.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Security Studies, International Relations, Criminal Justice, Business Management, or a related field
At least 3-5 years of relevant experience in physical threat monitoring, corporate intelligence and / or a geopolitical analysis-focused role
At least 1-3 years of leadership / management experience
Expert knowledge of threat monitoring tools, open-source research techniques, and mass notification systems (e.g. Everbridge)
Knowledge and awareness of geopolitical risks, crime trends, terrorism, armed conflict, and environmental hazards, among other emerging threats
Strong awareness of how global security incidents are liable to impact private-sector staff, assets, and operations – particularly in the technology sector
Fluency in English (both written and verbal)
Ability to manipulate and visualise data, using advanced research skills
Ability to rapidly digest, evaluate and ""sift"" large quantities of information
Ability to quickly determine how security events and crises impact business operations
Analytical flair: the ability to provide rigorous, creative insight into complex situations
Able to work in both individual and team environments
Excellent attention to detail
High level of competency with MS Office tools
A visionary mindset, with the ability to inspire others through expert guidance
Preferred Requirements
Advanced (Master's or above) degree in a relevant subject
Foreign language skills
Experience and technical competency with analytical software (e.g. IBM i2, Tableau, Splunk, Recorded Future, Palantir etc.)
Knowledge or expertise in at least one of the following: (1) environmental hazards, natural disasters and/or climate change risks; or (2) geographic information system (GIS) mapping software (e.g. ESRI)
Cross-functional experience within a global security team (e.g. Threat monitoring, travel security, business continuity and crisis management), particularly in a leadership role
Successful candidates will be invited to complete a writing assessment (at an arranged time to suit you) to test writing and analytical ability.

[Company name masked] is looking for an outstanding threat monitoring professional and leader to join us in an embedded role within a client's Crisis Management team. Based in [Location masked] and reporting to the client's security leadership, the Embedded Team Leader will co-direct a 24/7 team of analysts spread across [Location masked], [Location masked] and [Location masked] as part of a tight-knit operation providing actionable intelligence and advice to decision makers.
This position will manage the process for gathering timely and accurate information / intelligence on physical threats and risks to the client globally. The candidate must have previous exposure to tactical and operational security work in a leadership capacity, having worked their way up through the ranks of a GSOC, SOC or similar physical threat monitoring team (e.g., Operator, to Supervisor, to Lead). Candidates must have strong analysis skills, and be technically savvy with the ability to skilfully conceptualize and synthesise disparate information.
The candidate will be managed by the client's team leader day-to-day, but will also report to [Company name masked]'s Intelligence Operations team.

Therefore, in cases where candidates are equally qualified, preference will be given to women applicants in support of our gender balance commitment.

Based in [Location masked] and reporting to the client's security leadership, the Embedded Team Leader will co-direct a 24/7 team of analysts spread across [Location masked], [Location masked] and [Location masked] as part of a tight-knit operation providing actionable intelligence and advice to decision makers.
This position will manage the process for gathering timely and accurate information / intelligence on physical threats and risks to the client globally. cond_0606.responsibilities: Supervise the team's monitoring of open source, social media and vendor feeds for security risks and threats; Draft and review incident alerts and analytical reports that are timely, credible, and provide actionable insight to internal Crisis Management stakeholders; Provide thought leadership for internal stakeholders during ongoing incidents, senior management updates and crisis management / EMT briefings; Work with the client team to optimise processes and SOPs for delivering emergency notifications and assessments to internal customers; Demonstrate keen awareness for the concerns and needs of the client's staff and operations during emergencies and crises, engaging directly if necessary; Support the growth of the threat monitoring function within the client company by working in collaboration with other team leaders to develop and innovate assessment techniques; Display creative thinking and consulting skills to deliver a continually improving service for the client, supporting the global business; Be an effective leader of a small team, focused on the delivery of lean, high-impact services, whilst fostering a culture of resilience and innovation; and Work flexibly to ensure that client intelligence requirements are met.
cond_0606.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Security Studies, International Relations, Criminal Justice, Business Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 3–5 years of relevant experience in physical threat monitoring, corporate intelligence and / or a geopolitical analysis-focused role, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Around 1–3 years of leadership / management experience.
Working knowledge of threat monitoring tools, open-source research techniques, and mass notification systems (e.g. Everbridge).
Familiarity with geopolitical risks, crime trends, terrorism, armed conflict, and environmental hazards, among other emerging threats.
Background in understanding how global security incidents can impact private-sector staff, assets, and operations – particularly in the technology sector.
Fluency in English (both written and verbal).
Ability to manipulate and visualise data, using solid research skills.
Ability to rapidly digest, evaluate and ""sift"" large quantities of information.
Willingness to guide and support others through clear, grounded direction.
Ability to quickly determine how security events and crises impact business operations.
Ability to provide rigorous, creative insight into complex situations.
Able to work in both individual and team environments.
Attention to detail.
Comfort with MS Office tools.
Advanced (Master's or above) degree in a relevant subject is a plus.
Foreign language skills are a plus.
Some experience with analytical software (e.g. IBM i2, Tableau, Splunk, Recorded Future, Palantir etc.) is helpful; willingness to develop these skills is welcome.
Exposure to at least one of the following is useful: (1) environmental hazards, natural disasters and/or climate change risks; or (2) geographic information system (GIS) mapping software (e.g. ESRI).
Cross-functional experience within a global security team (e.g. Threat monitoring, travel security, business continuity and crisis management), particularly in a leadership role.
